name: s81lk_serdes_col_lp7b
landed_note: S81-SERDES 10-19: lp.py landed column from the wires-only flat parent ot_pdie_serdes_col_flat (spec tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_pdie_serdes_col_lp4.json). Clock families (COORDINATOR LEAD-S81 10-19 11:53): clk -> ck_tx, ck_r0, ck_r1, ck_ptx, ck_rxo; pma_rck (recovered, NOT the core PLL) -> ck_syn, ck_dly, ck_chn, ck_out. The only rck->clk crossings are the CDC children u_rm (closed gray-FIFO rate matcher, elastic IDLE deletion) and u_sts (2-flop status syncs) plus the regional reset runs (>= 4 stages per region = synchronisers); no landing crosses the families. related_same_frequency is the landed-cluster STA convention (as the closed s81lk_rate_match tile); the CDC is structural, proven by tb_s81_pdie_col with die B 300 ppm slow.

reset_landing.reason: lp6 regional_reset_ports: each region's reset port rst_<r> is landed by the lp.py regional reset forest (4 registered stages on that region's own clock, beside its pin); no plain fanout from a port, no cross-region reset path

structural_change: DRIVE-S81-PHY2 10-21 lpk7b (COORD DRIVE-S81 10-21 00:35 option b): lpk6b + flat7 (tx face register u_txf dropped: the closed encoder registers its tx_d pins; lpk6b ck_tx soft-vs-child 136 ps came from u_txf flops TT 603-739 vs enc 527-584; TX -1 edge). Merged decoder region ck_dec unchanged; its hard-child pair spread (lpk6b TT syn-dly 243 / dly-out 285) is judged by ROUTED timing (TT setup / FF hold) under the scoped clock_rule_waiver (job.json; textbook_lint SCOPED_CLOCK_WAIVER_CAPS s81lk_serdes_col_lp7b, Gate-Rule relaxing applies-to=s81lk_serdes_col_lp7b). DRIVE-S81-PHY 10-20 lpk6b: lpk6 + region prx {u_prx, u_live_r} (lpk6 gate CTS: ck_dec spanned the PMA rx S-face clock pin to the decoder stack, 3.4 mm, wire 1.6-2.5 ns, TT spread 535; ck_tx 81.4/FF 157.8, ck_r0/r1/ptx/rxo PASS). DRIVE-S81-PHY 10-20 lpk6 after the lpk5b rev2 gate FAIL (ep5 ref_gate/s81lk_serdes_col_lp5-20261020-0355xx, 14:32: 7 cross_clock reset-root FAILs TT -32..-205; clock_rule soft-vs-child spreads ck_tx 182, ck_r0 185, ck_dly 133, ck_chn 189, ck_out 278; GRT 8.5 h): (1) decoder tiles syn/dly/chn/out + PMA RX + rate-matcher write side = ONE region ck_dec (11 landings, ~10k soft ring flops gone; children register every pin, links <= ~250 um); (2) rate matcher storage = dual-clock SRAM (4,096 flops gone; SAFE 5 met); (3) regional reset ports rst_<r> beside each region clock pin, forest-landed 4 stages: no cross-region reset path. TX lane regions tx/r0/r1/ptx + rxo unchanged. S81-SERDES5 10-20 lpk5b: lpk5 mapped native census FAIL (ep9 030200: 301 > 32, max 219): 155 landing writer rq nets x 88-120 (rq gated every slot bit) -> registered per-slot write enables (ot_pl_land_regwe.sv, lp spec landing_reg_we); rate matcher q_v 219 / idle 49 / slice nets 42-45 / e 37-38 -> kept per-slice write control (push + one-hot write pointer) and read control (empty + one-hot read pointer, read enables), IDLE value ORed by e. Same regions, pins, children, outline. S81-LINK4 10-20 lpk5 (S81.STA.OWN.7): lpk4 mapped native census REFUSED 101 drivers > 32 (Codex d1d3da6c3: landing read counters rc 1,095-2,187 loads, one-hot selects 512-1,026, rate matcher rp 1,248-1,752 / row enables 512 / empty 1,539 / read reset 535). lp5 = same 9 regions, pins and children; landing_chunk_bits 24 + landing_reset_forest (kept per-chunk selectors + reset leaves) and u_rm = ot_s81_rate_match_n32 (24 kept slices, registered decision copies, 3-stage pointer syncs, kept 2-level reset trees). lpk4 gate (ep6 225834) kept as diagnostic: per-region TT insertion spreads 152-605 ps, setup -235 ps. S81-LINK3 10-19 lpk4 (S81.STA.OWN.7): lpk3 gate2 FAIL = ck_tx one clock region over the whole 1.3 mm TX lane plus the rx/st outputs (4855 sinks, TT insertion 0.92-1.75 ns, pin spread 165 ps, setup -622 ps on relay row u_txr1; reset-root hops -126..-391 ps from the 1.5 ns tx insertion). Rebuilt structurally: TX lane = 4 clk regions in one straight E column (tx: face reg + encoder, encoder moved W->E top at 259.2,3585.6 under the tx pins; r0, r1: one relay row each; ptx: PMA TX), every hop a D4/E2 landing (2-cycle wire <= ~470 um); RX output = own clk region rxo (rate-matcher read side, status-sync clk side, 2-stage rx/st out regs up the W column to the N face, rx pins moved over the W column). RX rck regions unchanged. Cost: TX +9 edges (was +3), rx/st +8 (was +7), static, in the lp4 record compiler block. S81-SERDES 10-19 (S81.STA.OWN.7): the SerDes column as an lp.py LANDED parent (replaces the draft s81lk_serdes_col_e3, which could not gen: kind cluster + multiple_cts_roots needs an lp record). All glue moved into children (live flags, status CDC, TX face/relay rows); decoder tiles are direct children in 4 rck regions with 11 D4/E2 landings (+6 edges); TX lane enc -> 2 relay rows -> landing tx->ptx (+3 edges) -> PMA TX; rx/st output regs; PMA RX moved to the W half under dsyn, PMA TX to the E half under the TX lane drop; 518.4 x 3844.8 approved slot. lpk3 (LEAD2-S81/LINK 10-19): lpk2 failed PDN-0006 (PMA M4 PG fully under its own M5 OBS); PMA abstracts v1.1 expose PG as M5 stripes on the parent 5.4 um lattice with M5 OBS only between them, strapped M5->M6 like hard children (macros[].pg_layer M5).

job.purpose: S81 SerDes column lpk7b = lpk6b + no u_txf (flat7); merged ck_dec judged by routed timing (scoped clock_rule_waiver), gate --cts

job.mut_note: lp7b has no alignment pads (MUT 3 = pad 0 short has nothing to shorten): mutants 1, 2, 4 + region audit

cdc_note: lp6: rate matcher = control u_rm (ot_s81_rate_match_sr, soft CDC child: write side ck_dec, read side ck_rxo, 2-stage gray syncs) + storage u_rmm = dual-clock SRAM ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x546_m1 (raw macro sink of BOTH roots: wclk ck_dec, rclk ck_rxo; raw_macro_clocks dual form). Status sync u_sts soft CDC child (ck_r ck_dec, ck_t ck_rxo). lpk2: the landed-cluster gate refuses a HARD child whose clock pins sit on two region roots (lpk1 FAIL 'OT_LANDED: hard child u_rm clock pins on different region roots'), so the rate matcher u_rm (same RTL as the closed s81lk_rate_match tile: 8 x 512 gray-pointer elastic FIFO) and the status sync u_sts are SOFT CDC children synthesised in the parent: write side on ck_out, read side on ck_tx.
